title: Multivariate weighted alternating-sign matrices have a totally-symmetric-plane-partition Schur expansion
author: Fischer, Ilse; Schreier-Aigner, Florian
work: Alternating sign matrices and totally symmetric plane partitions
difficulty_reason: The proof derives an antisymmetrizer-to-determinant identity, extracts Schur coefficients, and matches a Durfee-square deletion recursion with the refined plane-partition determinant. This nonroutine uniform multivariate identity is preserved with the full recurrence proof, not merely ordinary ASM enumeration.
